results.question: Show the order IDs of cancelled orders placed in 2026.

results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_upi_payments FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed' AND method = 'upi'

results.question: What is the average unit price of products in the Audio category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN categories parent ON c.parent_category_id = parent.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Audio' OR parent.name = 'Audio'
results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Audio'

results.question: What are the total shipping fees collected from orders that were not cancelled?

results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(shipping_fee), 2) AS shipping_total FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

results.question: How many cancelled orders used each payment method?

results.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY payment_method

results.question: Which brand earned the most revenue from delivered orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.carrier FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.shipping_city = 'Seattle' AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many distinct customers have returned at least one item?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

results.question: On average, how many days pass between an order date and its shipment date?

results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.shipped_at) - julianday(o.order_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id

results.question: Which customers have placed at least 8 orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 8 ORDER BY order_count DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 8

results.question: Which product categories have an average review rating below 3?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3 ORDER BY avg_rating ASC
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3 ORDER BY avg_rating

results.question: Which tags appear on products in the Fiction category?
